verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs confirm the `[[` shortcut for linking notes and a backlinks list of incoming links from other notes. Search can also filter notes by where they are backlinked to or from. Nothing in the pack shows unlinked mentions, or whether backlinks appear with surrounding context, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: unlinked-mention detection, backlinks shown in context, independent or hands-on corroboration.
